persona.name: Andrea Reyes
persona.summary: Andrea is a Project Manager at Cebu Solutions, a 60-person IT services company. Company knowledge lives in Slack, email, Google Workspace, and Jira — predominantly Tagalog with English engineering threads.
persona.situation: A billing database migration from MySQL to Postgres is planned next sprint, led by Andrea. The Cebu warehouse reports an inventory discrepancy on SKU-6720, and the team needs to decide whether a read replica is needed before the Postgres cutover.

scopes.label: db-migration
scopes.business_meaning: The billing database migration from MySQL to Postgres: planning, risk, and cutover timeline.

scopes.label: inventory-discrepancy
scopes.business_meaning: Cebu warehouse inventory discrepancy on SKU-6720: short by 95 units, investigating scan error.

scopes.label: client-communication
scopes.business_meaning: Client communication: stakeholder updates, change requests, and status reports.

messages.body: Desisyon: ilipat ang database ng pagsingil mula MySQL patungong Postgres sa susunod na sprint; may-akda si Andrea, panganib ang downtime habang nagpapalit.

Kinukumpirma ni Andrea ang plano ng Postgres cutover: Hakbang 1 i-export ang MySQL data, Hakbang 2 isagawa ang cutover sa maintenance window, Hakbang 3 i-verify ang data integrity. Inaasahang downtime ng 2 oras.
Engineering note (English): 'The MySQL to Postgres migration script is tested in staging. Andrea approved the production cutover for Saturday 2-4 AM PHT. A read replica will be set up first.'

Iniulat ng bodega ng Cebu ang pagkakaiba sa imbentaryo: kulang ng 95 units ang SKU-6720 kumpara sa sistema; iniimbestigahan ang scan error. Pinuno ng bodega na si Mark ay nagkumpirma sa physical count.
Sanhi: ang lumang barcode scanner ay maaaring makaligtaan ang ilang scan. Na-update ng IT team ang firmware ng scanner at muling binilang ang SKU-6720.
Update sa kliyente: Naipadala na ang status report tungkol sa Postgres migration. Sinabi ni Andrea na ang read replica ay naka-set up at handa na para sa cutover sa Sabado.

recall_tests.intent: Find the database migration plan and owner.

synthesis.business_question: What is the database migration plan, who owns it, and what is the risk?

forget.rationale: The inventory discrepancy has been resolved after firmware update and recount; the records can be purged.
